<h2>Run One Selected sjSDM Fold</h2>

<h3>Description</h3>

<p>Prepares, fits, and predicts one live selected-candidate fold, then delegates
all persisted row construction to [build_sjsdm_selected_fold_artifacts()].
</p>


<h3>Usage</h3>

<pre><code class='language-R'>run_sjsdm_selected_fold(
  list_fold_context = NULL,
  data_candidate = NULL,
  data_sample_ids = NULL,
  taxon_names = NULL,
  regularization_source = NULL,
  prepare_fold_function = NULL,
  fit_function = NULL,
  predict_function = NULL,
  seed = 900723L
)
</code></pre>


<h3>Arguments</h3>

<table role = "presentation">
<tr><td><code id="list_fold_context">list_fold_context</code></td>
<td>
<p>Fold context returned by [build_sjsdm_tuning_fold_context()].</p>
</td></tr>
<tr><td><code id="data_candidate">data_candidate</code></td>
<td>
<p>One-row selected candidate table without provenance-only fields.</p>
</td></tr>
<tr><td><code id="data_sample_ids">data_sample_ids</code>, <code id="taxon_names">taxon_names</code></td>
<td>
<p>Normalized sample metadata and full ordered response-taxon names.</p>
</td></tr>
<tr><td><code id="regularization_source">regularization_source</code></td>
<td>
<p>Source label for the selected regularization candidate.</p>
</td></tr>
<tr><td><code id="prepare_fold_function">prepare_fold_function</code>, <code id="fit_function">fit_function</code>, <code id="predict_function">predict_function</code></td>
<td>
<p>Injectable selected-fold lifecycle functions.</p>
</td></tr>
<tr><td><code id="seed">seed</code></td>
<td>
<p>Non-negative base integer used to derive the stable fold fit seed.</p>
</td></tr>
</table>


<h3>Value</h3>

<p>Named list with one fold's prediction and diagnostic artifacts.
</p>

</main>
